reuse.why: The change reuses budget, spreadsheet, averaging, and undo helpers, but setZero and copyPreviousMonth bypass the new shared category selector.

duplication.why: Category eligibility is maintained in three implementations despite introducing getBulkBudgetCategories.

placement.why: Budget operations remain in actions.ts and handler registration follows the existing app.ts layering.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested month-wide actions, their registration, and supporting tests.

maintainability.why: Consolidating average actions helps, but future eligibility changes still require coordinated edits across SQL filters and imperative checks.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: setZero duplicates getBulkBudgetCategories SQL, while copyPreviousMonth implements eligibility through getBudgetData and local checks.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth reshapes the selector's hidden, fixed-group, and template exclusions into getBudgetData projections and imperative guards.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and a conditional SQL clause, but setZero and copyPreviousMonth retain separate implementations of its eligibility policy.
